title: NK6130 BGT Corn (NK6130): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: NK6130 BGT Corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: NK6130 BGT corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety for Luzon and Mindanao. 106 to 109 days to harvest, 9.7 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: NK6130 BGT corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety, also sold or known as NK6130 or NK6130 E Z Refuge. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2023 as NSIC 2023 GMCn 93. Syngenta bred it. It takes 106 to 109 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 9.74 tonnes per hectare in the trials (10.56 in Luzon, 8.92 in Mindanao).

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

NK6130 BGT corn takes 106 to 109 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is about the average of the 89 yellow GM hybrid corn varieties with a day count, 105.4 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 9.74 t/ha beats the average of its group, 8.13. It sits in the top quarter of its group. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing. Its seller gives 110 to 115 days after planting.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer).

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Its ears grew about 17.25 cm long in the trials. The shelling recovery was 79.87 percent, the share of the ear weight that comes off as grain. A higher share means more grain from every sack of ears.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Yield:** Potential 11.6 t/ha, brochure claims 20 to 30 more cavans per ha than rival hybrids, depending on fertilizer management.

**Traits in the seed:** BGT stack Bt11 x TC1507 x GA21: Bt proteins against Asian corn borer and other caterpillars, plus glyphosate tolerance (GA21). Sold as EZ Refuge: the brochures say 5 percent refuge seed is already blended in the bag.
**Where:** Low to mid elevations in Cagayan Valley, Panay, CALABARZON, Bicol, Caraga, South Mindanao, Ilocos, Central Luzon and Occidental Mindoro.
**Elevation:** Low to mid elevation.
**Stand:** 70,000 to 80,000 plants per ha, furrows 70 cm, hills 20 cm.
Heavy grain (company).
Good standability, sturdy stalk.
Ears set at moderate height.
Seed comes treated with Fortenza (cyantraniliprole), the brochure says it guards seedlings against fall armyworm for 2 to 3 weeks after emergence.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: on Syngenta's current corn list (listed twice, as NK6130 and NK6130 BGT), its brochure claims first place at the 2022 wet season Camarines Norte provincial derby in Daet (11.17 t/ha) and the 2022 Region 5 derby in Bombon, Camarines Sur (11.15 t/ha), plus a Cordillera derby award (11.49 t/ha). These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual corn on the same ground.
Where and when to plant NK6130 BGT corn

It is recommended for Luzon and Mindanao. Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items.q: Is NK6130 the same as NK6130 BGT?
items.a: Yes. NK6130 is another name for NK6130 BGT, registered as NSIC 2023 GMCn 93. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes 106 to 109 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 9.74 tonnes per hectare in the trials (10.56 in Luzon, 8.92 in Mindanao). Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.
It is recommended for Luzon and Mindanao. Ask your municipal agriculturist how it has done in your town.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of NK6130 BGT?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
